feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 2 June 2026 10:53pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 02 June 2026 at 10:50pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds tomorrow.


##Synopsis##

Complex areas of low pressure around and to the west of Britain, with a weather front crossing the Irish Sea tomorrow.


##Wind##

West or southwest 3 or 4, occasionally 5. Backing south or southwest 5 or 6 tomorrow morning, occasionally 7 until late evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building moderate tomorrow morning, occasionally rough in places.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, then rain tomorrow morning, scattered showers in the afternoon and evening.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in showers or rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest veering west 5 or 6, increasing 6 or 7 Thursday evening.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, moderate to rough in places.


##Weather##

Occasional showers or rain.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers or rain.
